title: 52-in-1 electric smart driver zeroes in on near-autonomous screwing
caption:
Tired of stripping tiny screws? This new AI-powered driver uses an HD camera to identify the exact bit you need so you don't have to guess. It even sets the torque automatically.

Source: Newatlas - 52-in-1 electric smart driver zeroes in on near-autonomous screwing

https://newatlas.com/knives-multitools/arrowspace-52-in-1-ai-screwdriver/
